verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community tuning tip about disabling the refresh interval during bulk indexing, which implies Elasticsearch supports bulk indexing workloads. No first-party documentation in the pack describes a bulk API or multi-item update/delete operations. Missing for 10: first-party docs for a bulk API, evidence of bulk update/delete (e.g. update-by-query or delete-by-query), evidence of agent- or MCP-driven bulk operations, and hands-on corroboration.
